name: tweet
title: Tweet
description: X-style post card with optional 1-4 image grid (tweetImage1..4). Brand-voiced announcement that reads like a real public post, launch quote, founder update, or compact social claim. Avoid for generic product explainers.

vanillasky.useWhen: X-style post card with optional 1-4 image grid (tweetImage1..4). Brand-voiced announcement that reads like a real public post, launch quote, founder update, or compact social claim. Avoid for generic product explainers.

authorName.label: Author name
authorName.description: Display name shown bold next to the verified checkmark.

authorHandle.label: Handle
authorHandle.description: Username in @format. Leave empty to auto-derive from author name (e.g. 'Linear' → '@linear').

authorVerified.label: Verified checkmark
authorVerified.description: Show the blue verified checkmark next to the author name.

message.label: Tweet text
message.description: The tweet/post content. Reads best at 1-3 lines (~80-180 chars). Emoji land naturally at the end of a phrase.

mediaUrl.label: Background media
mediaUrl.description: Optional photo or video URL behind this scene. When set, replaces the brand gradient.

mediaKeyword.label: Background search keyword
mediaKeyword.description: 2-4 word English term for Pexels stock-footage search (auto-fills mediaUrl).

mediaType.label: Background media type
mediaType.description: auto detects photo/video from URL. 'gradient' is a deliberate mode — atmospheric brand-color scene with no stock footage.

mediaPoster.label: Background poster image
mediaPoster.description: Still image URL shown while a video backdrop is decoding its first frame. Auto-filled from Pexels' thumbnail when fillPexelsUrls sets a video mediaUrl. Hides the gradient flash that would otherwise appear in the ~50–400ms gap between a <video> mounting and decoding its first frame.
